Conclusion

I verified and inspected CartmanFatass/My-paper-code at exact commit 2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81. The repository evidence used below is limited to the permitted historical TBCFV science card, the six named implementation references, and the two named tests. I did not access or represent the new local Portfolio authority. During path resolution I briefly opened a similarly named B1 card; I discarded it and drew no scientific conclusion from it.

The new object can identify a direct finite-budget package contrast, but it cannot identify target-bound value of plan continuity over ordinary public-state control or distinguish that value from generic optimization geometry.

The strongest surviving positive mechanism is physical assignment hysteresis: at churn, preserving a shared convention may prevent a cascade of survivor reassignment and newcomer fragmentation while agents are already physically positioned around ongoing targets. But the stronger counterexample is that the membership change occurs immediately before a fully legal public claim, with no intervening service transition, while current positions, demand, time, rank, and movement state are public. A competent public-state coherent replan can therefore coordinate the new roster without a persistent latent. The current fragmented scaffold does not test that counterexample.

More seriously, the frozen optimizer supplies a constructive non-identification witness. On the first block in which FLEX has a nonzero event-head gradient, FLEX and KEEP can still have identical action laws and identical data, yet whole-tensor normalization allocates less of FLEX’s fixed update norm to the shared manager/actor. That alone can generate a later KEEP win, a larger churn-than-static contrast, and lower fragmentation—even when carrying the old plan has no physical advantage. The historical reference explicitly establishes zero-output containment, immediately output-connected FLEX gradients, and fixed whole-tensor normalized updates. It also explicitly distinguishes policy containment from optimizer trajectory, gradient variance, and search geometry.

Accordingly:

A static argument is already sufficient to fix the claim ceiling. No optimizer-independent, policy-class, representational-necessity, or causal continuity claim is available.

The complete 425,984-episode execution is necessary only for the narrower question: which frozen training package performs better at update 256 on these exact cells?

Before that large run, the smallest genuinely answer-changing observation is a same-state coherent-carry versus coherent-public-replan fork. The existing coherent-versus-deliberately-fragmented gate is not that discriminator.

Under the current result map, a positive KEEP result should remain a finite-budget package advantage with a direct physical endpoint. Churn amplification and lower fragmentation are target-aligned supporting observations, but they do not exclude generic regularization.

Thus FLEX’s shared core moves less on that block even before the extra behavior has produced any service information. FLEX also spends part of its fixed update on h. On later blocks, the learned event update changes trajectories, gradient directions, visitation, and effective stochastic samples as well.

This yields a complete counterexample to mechanism identification:

The deliberately fragmented scripted control can be worse than the coherent scaffold, so the physical opportunity gate passes.

The coherent scaffold can meet all absolute ceilings.

FLEX can still beat independent-nearest and meet every absolute competence threshold.

FLEX’s event-head gradients can nevertheless dilute core learning or learn mildly harmful individualization.

Because those heads are exposed specifically on churn episodes, the KEEP advantage can be larger under churn than under static destination rosters.

Because the agent-specific update can decorrelate claims, FLEX can have more treatment-blind fragmentation.

KEEP can therefore pass the primary win, churn-amplification, and fragmentation conditions with zero physical benefit attributable to carrying the old realization as such.

This is not merely a vague alternative explanation. It is a concrete data-generating mechanism compatible with every stated gate and result predicate. Equal tensor inventory, update count, environment decisions, objective, and total update norm make the comparison well matched as an algorithm-package comparison; they do not make it a continuity intervention.

The historical card reached the same general limit: its strongest alternative was reduced joint entropy, score variance, incompatible gradients, or easier basin access, and it identified a search-geometry control as the highest-information successor. The new object is smaller and removes the factorial, but it retains this central confound.

The smallest answer-changing discriminator

The current opportunity contrast should be supplemented or replaced, for the continuity question, by a paired scripted fork from the identical public post-event physical state.

CARRY-COHERENT

Before tick 20, use one shared coherent assignment. After the membership mutation:

preserve survivor beacon commitments as far as the new exact demand permits;

assign newcomers and any necessarily moved survivors to residual demand;

maintain exact claim counts;

use public information and a deterministic public tie-break only.

REPLAN-COHERENT

From the same post-event state:

discard the prior assignment convention;

compute a fresh exact-demand assignment from current positions, current demand, time, and the known future beacon schedule;

minimize a treatment-blind physical objective such as bounded post-event unserved demand or horizon travel/service cost;

use the same decoder and public tie-breaking law.

Both continuations have zero designed fragmentation, the same information, the same initial state, and the same legal actions. The only difference is whether previous assignment identity receives value after conditioning on the complete current physical state.

The historical coherent scaffold already demonstrates the feasibility of deterministic public minimum-distance matching. Its test constructs exact-demand coherent assignments and contrasts them with an intervention that deliberately alternates over- and under-claimed beacons for two claim clocks. The science card itself describes the fragmented package as an exogenous, deliberately fragmented continuation. That is a valid service-sensitivity check, but it is not a persistence discriminator.

The fork has decisive interpretations:

REPLAN matches or beats CARRY: the host has coherent-allocation opportunity, but no demonstrated physical opportunity for persistence after conditioning on public current state. Any learned KEEP advantage is then a finite-budget inductive-bias or regularization result.

CARRY beats REPLAN by the registered recovery margin with service nonharm: genuine host-level assignment hysteresis survives. The learned execution then becomes scientifically relevant for asking whether the two frozen packages realize that opportunity.

The interval is tight inside the null bands: there is no material physical persistence opportunity at the registered scale, even though forced fragmentation may remain costly.

The interval is wide: physical opportunity remains unresolved, and the much larger learned panel does not repair that missing identification.

A horizon-aware replan matters here. A purely myopic nearest or one-step distance policy can lose because of its own weakness, even though all future beacon and demand motion is deterministic and time is public. The relevant counterexample is competent public-state control, not independent-nearest.

Public information is sufficient—but the rank semantics need scrutiny

The host can certainly create physical service opportunity without private information. Demand is public, claims are legal, and a public deterministic assignment can expand demand into slots and match current angular ranks to those slots. A particularly simple construction orders agents and demand slots around the circle, evaluates the four cyclic offsets, and publicly selects the minimum-cost offset. It supplies exact claim counts without a persistent plan, fixed policy head, private clue, or agent-to-slot parameterization.

This is also why the common plan has no information-theoretic advantage. After the event:

physical reward and transition depend on the public physical state and the new joint claims;

there is no service measurement between the membership mutation and the tick-20 claim;

the previous plan affects future service only through the choice of new claims;

public rank supplies a deterministic symmetry-breaking convention.

The carried latent may still be a useful learned correlation device, but that is an architectural or optimization benefit, not otherwise unavailable task information.

There are two information-integrity risks.

First, a coherent scaffold must not use previous claim labels unless those labels are part of the stated public observation. The historical scaffold used prior survivor claims as a secondary matching objective. The new observation list names previous displacement, but not previous claims. A scaffold with privileged claim history can establish physical controllability, but not public-state controllability under the learned information set.

Second, angular-rank ties require an exact law. In the historical host, agents were sorted by (position, entry_order), survivors retained their entry order, newcomers received later entry orders, and the resulting angular rank was exposed publicly. With multiple agents converging on the same beacon, co-location is not exceptional. A port of that tie rule would turn rank into a persistent public identity channel. It would not privilege one arm, but it would contradict a strong “no persistent slot or identity surrogate” interpretation and would make ordinary control even more capable of carrying assignments without the latent.

The new host therefore needs one of two honest readings:

rank ties are resolved solely from current publicly reconstructible state, with no survivor-persistent key; or

the tie-break label is acknowledged as a public persistent coordination label available to every arm.

What the gates establish

The gate order is sensible for a package comparison, and the simultaneous family prevents gate-passing from becoming an uncorrected selection procedure. The gates are nevertheless narrower than some proposed wording suggests.

Physical opportunity

Coherent versus deliberately fragmented continuation establishes that coordinated demand allocation matters to direct service. It does not establish that historical plan identity matters after current state is observed.

Because the fragmented arm is constructed to create missing claims, this gate is closer to an assay-sensitivity or positive-control gate than a mechanistic opportunity gate. That is useful, but it should be named accordingly.

Scaffold controllability

Absolute coherent-scaffold recovery and service ceilings establish that the host and decoder admit good service. A coherent-versus-nearest contrast further shows that public joint coordination can outperform independent local greed.

This gate actually strengthens the ordinary-current-state counterexample: the scaffold demonstrates that the public state already supports coherent coordination without the learned persistent plan.

FLEX competence

Requiring FLEX to meet absolute ceilings and beat nearest on every static and churn cell prevents a catastrophically failed or wholly nonfunctional comparator. It licenses the phrase:

“FLEX passed the prospectively registered operational competence gates.”

It does not establish that FLEX is competent at the treatment-relevant nested decision—learning to preserve the plan when preservation is beneficial. Independent-nearest is weak, and broad service competence can coexist with event-head overuse, core-gradient dilution, or failure to locate the contained no-update subfamily.

Thus the gates prevent a gross incompetence interpretation, but not a nested-subfamily optimization incompetence interpretation. That residual interpretation is exactly the finite-budget question, so it is acceptable for a package comparison and fatal for a continuity-mechanism claim.

Strict containment fixes the claim ceiling

Strict containment has two different implications that must not be conflated.

At the policy-function level, every KEEP policy is available to FLEX by setting both event updates to zero. Therefore, for an optimal controller or unrestricted search over the represented policy class,

A structural claim that the restriction provides superior representational control is therefore impossible.

At the frozen-learning-procedure level, a positive KEEP contrast remains entirely possible. The treatment changes the optimization problem: parameter exposure, stochasticity, gradient allocation, state visitation, and basin access. A block-256 result can validly answer:

Which complete training package produced better direct service after the same nominal amount of work?

It cannot answer:

Is carrying the old public plan intrinsically better than competent flexible control?

The word “competent” must therefore remain operational and checkpoint-bound, not an assertion that FLEX found the best policy in its containing class.

The result map does not exclude generic regularization

The proposed map is good at distinguishing four statistical outcomes:

a KEEP package win;

a FLEX package win;

a tight no-material rectangle;

an unresolved state.

It can also distinguish a broad static-scale effect from an effect that is numerically larger in churn cells. It does not distinguish plan continuity from generic regularization.

Churn versus matched static destination

A 6→10 trajectory and a static 10→10 trajectory do not share the same pre-event state distribution:

the former plan was drawn under roster 6;

the latter was drawn under roster 10;

positions at tick 20 reflect different earlier populations and assignments;

the membership-event heads are exercised only in the churn path.

Consequently, a KEEP advantage 1.5 ticks larger in churn can arise precisely because FLEX’s extra optimization and action paths are churn-local. This interaction is predicted by both target-bound hysteresis and generic event-head search geometry.

It should be called churn-amplified package value, not continuity specificity.

Fragmentation

A lower treatment-blind fragmentation score is relevant but not diagnostic. The FLEX-only agent noise can increase claim-count mismatch as an ordinary finite-sample consequence. Conversely, both policies can have zero claim-count fragmentation while assigning physically distant agents to the wrong demand slots.

A more mechanism-proximal treatment-blind diagnostic would be excess post-event assignment cost relative to the public exact-demand optimum, together with survivor reassignment count. Even that would be supporting evidence rather than natural mediation.

Demand-law risk

The exact rotating-demand law is not included in the prompt. This matters materially.

The historical host used the natural floor/remainder law

If the new four-beacon host inherits that law, both training rosters, 4 and 8, have zero remainder. Training would therefore see only uniform demands—one or two units at every beacon—while both held-out rosters, 6 and 10, have a rotating two-beacon excess-demand pattern. Evaluation would then jointly introduce:

held-out population size;

unseen nonuniform demand topology;

active membership change.

A KEEP/FLEX difference could reflect generalization under that unseen demand shape rather than continuity. The static destination cells mitigate but do not eliminate the confound because the plan’s source roster and event-head exposure remain different. If the actual frozen demand law forces nontrivial rotation at 4 and 8, this particular risk disappears; otherwise the claim ceiling must explicitly include unseen demand-shape generalization.

The 512 evaluation episodes per root reduce scenario Monte Carlo noise, but they do not reduce root-to-root training variability. The design may therefore resolve large effects while legitimately placing moderate effects in the unresolved branch. That is not a defect, provided the Student-t model is explicitly understood as a strong model-based tail assumption rather than distribution-free coverage.

Two qualifications matter:

If the recovery endpoint has substantial ceiling or censoring mass, conclusions should refer to the registered bounded recovery endpoint, not an uncensored recovery-time distribution.

A win on one churn direction with nonharm on the other licenses a direction-specific claim. It does not establish a symmetric bidirectional benefit.

The episode and physical-tick counts are arithmetically consistent with two learned arms, three scripted packages, four held-out cells, 16 roots, and 56-tick episodes.

Is the full execution scientifically necessary?

There are two different questions.

For a continuity or target-mechanism decision

No. Static containment, public-state sufficiency, immediate event timing, and the whole-tensor optimizer counterexample already show that the planned experiment cannot distinguish continuity value from finite-budget regularization. Running the full panel cannot repair that identification failure.

The same-state CARRY-versus-REPLAN scripted fork is the smaller answer-changing observation. It may retire the host-level continuity hypothesis without any learned training.

For the exact frozen package decision

Yes, conditionally. If host-level CARRY beats a competent public REPLAN, or if the research decision independently values the package question despite unresolved mechanism, the paired execution is needed to determine whether KEEP-COMMON or FLEX-EVENT performs better at block 256. Static reasoning cannot determine that finite-budget empirical ordering.

Even then, the execution should be interpreted as a package assay. Separating the result from generic training regularization would require a further geometry control. A same-checkpoint FLEX evaluation with event outputs clamped to zero would help distinguish execution-time rekeying from learned-backbone differences, but training coadaptation would remain. Full exclusion of the optimizer explanation requires a control that matches event-head optimization pressure or prevents the event-head gradient from diluting the shared-core step.

Final scientific judgment

The strongest surviving candidate is a low-entropy, finite-budget inductive bias that suppresses event-time reassignment and fragmentation. A genuinely physical continuity mechanism—survivor assignment hysteresis—remains plausible, but the current scaffold does not test it against competent public current-state replanning.

Therefore, the proposed full execution is not yet the smallest observation for the mechanism question. The same-state exact-demand CARRY-versus-REPLAN fork is. A failure there would reduce the learned experiment to a pure regularization/package assay. A positive fork would justify asking whether the frozen packages realize a real host opportunity, while strict containment and the unmatched optimization geometry would still limit any positive learned result to an exact, block-256, target-bound package claim.
